name: smwmusic-stardew-valley-star-lumpy
title: Stardew Valley - Star Lumpy
description:
This is a theme that you hear in Stardew Valley in the first few caves you enter. The only instrument present for the most part in this is the marimba, or @3. It's a good song for those sparkly cave settings.

There's two versions. One loops when the song reaches the end, while the other one doesn't (the original did not loop).
